item.title: TIL the <a> tag has a download attribute
item.description: i spotted the download attribute on an anchor tag and assumed Content-Disposition already did the job. turns out it's for when you can't touch the server.

item.description: pnpm add rewrote package.json from CRLF to LF and git diffed the whole file. one line in gitattributes fixed it.

item.title: fake a non-retina screen on Chrome
item.description: a Chrome flag retired the old non-retina monitor I kept around just to test on.

item.title: make shift+enter a newline in Claude Code on Windows
item.description: shift+enter sent my half-written message instead of making a newline. ctrl+j fixes it in any terminal; a keybinding wins back the muscle memory.

item.title: keep an AVD session awake with f15
item.description: AVD logged me out over lunch and killed a long job. f15 is a key that does nothing, so I send one every two minutes to look busy.

item.title: reset Karabiner after sleep without a reboot
item.description: Karabiner stopped remapping after my Mac woke. i finally found a way to reset it without a reboot.

item.title: lazygit: open a file straight from the diff
item.description: to edit the file i'm looking at, i'd have to find it again in my editor. pressing `e` opens it directly, in whatever editor i configure.

item.title: disable Chrome's AI features with a macOS config profile
item.description: Chrome put AI in my address bar, and the flags I turned off came back after an update. a macOS config profile sets the enterprise policy that turns it off for good.

item.title: finding what freezes VS Code: tsserver log and extension host profile
item.description: cmd+click on a type froze VS Code, and the tsserver log looked healthy. an extension host profile found the culprit.

item.title: save the Chrome console to a file
item.description: a web app left open overnight showed errors in the morning. right-click the console, save as, and the whole session is a log file.
